findings_addressed.oracle: bridge.get_color_mode() called immediately after each set_color_mode(mode) and compared to the mode string just set; get_color_mode reads self._color_mode independently of set_color_mode's return value

findings_addressed.oracle: ceil_boundary = 1024 is a hand-computed constant (1000-512=488 > 1024-1000=24 proves 1024 is nearer); bridge return value, get_cursor_position(), and HexDocumentState.cursor_offset are each independently asserted against it

notes: G0129: Added get_color_mode() read-back assertion inside the loop, making the test falsifiable — a broken setter that stores the wrong mode or ignores the argument would fail.
